fusions.name: Heavyweight Hindkick
fusions.desc: A two-footed kick with your whole weight behind it. It deals 30 damage, throws the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Bluff Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and rears up, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Denning Leap
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles aside, then restore 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina runs out, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
